svg.title: RLHF pipeline compared to DPO pipeline
svg.desc: Both start from a supervised fine-tuned model. RLHF generates responses, collects human preference rankings, trains a separate reward model, then updates the policy with reinforcement learning using that reward model and a KL penalty. DPO instead takes human preference pairs directly and optimizes the policy with a single loss function, skipping the reward model and the reinforcement learning loop entirely, arriving at the same kind of aligned model.
svg.text: DPO reaches the same destination with one loss function instead of a reward model plus an RL loop
